result.summary: The page is mostly well-structured, but there is a clear text overlap defect in the 'Popular right now' section where the delivery time and '€0 delivery' metadata strings collide, plus a couple of minor polish issues.

issues.description: Under 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar', the metadata line shows overlapping text: '25–30 min' and '€0 delivery' are rendered on top of each other (appearing as garbled '25–30rdelivery'), making both pieces of information unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Fix the layout so the delivery time and delivery fee are separate, non-overlapping elements (e.g. flex row with a separator dot and proper spacing, or stack them). Ensure text containers size to their content instead of overlapping.

issues.description: The third card in 'Fastest near you' ('Trattoria Piccol...') is cut off at the right screen edge with no visual affordance indicating horizontal scrollability.
issues.suggestion: Add a scroll hint such as a peeking card edge with padding, a fade gradient, or a horizontal scroll indicator so users know more items are available.

issues.description: The notification bell icon in the top-right has a red badge dot with no numeric count or text alternative, so the meaning of the badge is unclear to screen reader users.
issues.suggestion: Provide an accessible label like 'Notifications, 1 unread' and ensure the badge conveys its count programmatically.
